name: Earthrealm warriors confront Quan Chi in the Netherrealm
description: After Shinnok is imprisoned and Quan Chi escapes, Johnny Cage, Sonya Blade, and Raiden pursue the sorcerer to his Netherrealm stronghold, where Jax, Scorpion, and Sub-Zero remain under Quan Chi's control. This Event establishes the confrontation context only; it does not automatically become the causal parent of each specific spell or fight that follows.
